Initial release of work-productivity-nano-banana-workflow-helper.

- Provides practical help for Nano Banana Pro-style workflows, including bug fixing, reliability, setup, safety, and adjacent skill creation.
- Designed for agent users and teams needing proven patterns adapted for local hardware or CPU-safe environments.
- Outputs tailored checklists, workflows, artifacts, or analysis based on user needs.
- Workflow includes restating user requirements, planning, minimal information requests, and clear validation steps.
- Triggered by productivity-related keywords and Nano Banana Pro workflow requests.
